instruction: A candid outdoor photograph of a group of friends gathered in a grassy park during a bright day. In the center foreground, a bald man in a dark blue t-shirt (R2) is captured from behind, standing with his back to the camera and pointing his right arm forward. In the background, a smiling woman with an afro in a red t-shirt (R6) stands on the left side of the lawn, while a man in a red polo shirt (R3) stands on the right, watching the action. The scene is shot from a medium-full perspective with natural daylight highlighting the green grass and surrounding trees.
